scope: Independent read-only review of the WorldFeatures camera delta. No product changes, build or live access.

tests.reported_result: Root reports 121 checks, zero failures. Reviewer read the cases but did not execute another build.

verdict: No new significant issue identified in this delta. The previously reported native-owner and incomplete-scene-lease issues are resolved.
verified: CameraAvailable now requires native producer AC1528 == 0 and controller submode +72 == 0.
Both held camera and FOV share a lease for field scheduler, scene heap, all 10 MapTarget bytes and controller submode.
CameraFrame and WorldTick clear both overrides on invalidation; returning to owner 0 does not reacquire the old lease.
19D340 receives the held up vector in R9. The following19D3D0 receives roll as argument 4 in XMM3 and leaves up intact.
Capture, API mutation and render application all require finite roll within plus/minus float pi.
Renderer writes require the game thread and nonzero heartbeat within 5000 ms. Bank 1 skips trainer writes.
CameraFrame forwards the original native task exactly once, including canceled paths and caught setter faults.
ClearCamera changes trainer state only. Normal follow refreshes native camera and FOV, so there is no stale raw baseline restoration.
test_cases_reviewed: Captured roll and preserved up vector, deferred write until render phase, all three native setter signatures.
Rejected NaN, Infinity, huge roll and values outside the supported radians range.
Native owner 1 takeover and return without reactivation; all nonzero owners rejected.
All 10 MapTarget byte changes, same-room heap replacement, scheduler replacement and submode replacement.
Host expiry, wrong-thread callback, secondary bank and forced setter SEH each preserve original forwarding.
limits: Static source and synthetic fixture review only; no live visual sign-convention or runtime test.
Broader World features were not re-reviewed in this delta.
CameraExtra queued actions are reviewed separately; this verdict does not yet cover that evolving source.
